question: Should this PR establish the expanded retry option types and shared workspace package as the long-term Plugin SDK/runtime boundary for these migrated callers?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but choosing a shared public retry boundary and accepting its additive hook semantics is an API-ownership decision that broad tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Keep the shared package, record approval of the retry option additions, and require redacted after-fix runtime output through the scheduler and one migrated adapter before merge.

options.title: Narrow the consolidation
options.body: Limit this PR to the memory-host Retry-After defect and defer the broader caller and Plugin SDK consolidation to separately reviewed work.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the shared package, record approval of the retry option additions, and require redacted after-fix runtime output through the scheduler and one migrated adapter before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the proposed consolidation and is identified by repository automation as an administrator able to confirm the intended API boundary.
